notes.title: V 1.1.0.3 more bug fixes
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed bug where by pressing the same upgrade a lot of times quickly it would continue fusing the card making overpowered cards. 
[*] Fixed small bug that was producing errors related to quickly selecting a card with controller or keyboard controls right after killing the last enemy.
[*] Fixed bug where two of the bone cards would not have the correct ability and one not showing the card image.
[*] Fixed visual bug where armor above 10 was appearing a bit offcentered & enemy intent + status effects were appearing above the number instead of behind it for values above 10.
[*] Fixed upgrade confirm button in the upgrade tree not getting pressed in some situations.
[/list]

notes.title: V 1.1.0.1 bugfix
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed UI bug with bigger numbers appearing too close to each other.
[*] Fixed “Just a bit harder” achievement unlocking after any hard mode run, now only unlocks if you win.
[*] Fixed appearing on negative health if you won and got burned in the last attack of the turn. (Now if you win, end of turn effects like burn and others will not trigger, making it more fair when fighting enemies that burn)
[*] Fixed Grave Barricade ability bug where it was replacing the deck with the discard instead of shuffling it back. Now it properly adds them to the deck.
[*] Fixed two card names that were not getting properly translated.
[/list]
